title: Implement CTA Banner section variants (cta-centered, cta-split)
description: Implement two CTA Banner variants. cta-centered shows centered headline, subheadline, and a large CTA button on a colored background. cta-split shows text on the left and CTA button on the right.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: CtaBannerContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Both render headline, optional subheadline, and CTA button
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Full-width section with `--color-primary` background. Centered: h2 headline (`--color-text-inverted`), p subheadline (muted inverted), large button with contrasting color (`--color-background` bg, `--color-primary` text). Phone number below button.
Two-column: left side has headline + subheadline (text on `--color-primary` bg), right side has CTA button + phone (centered vertically). On mobile: stack with button below text.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify text is readable on colored background, button is visible.
